scenario: Two friends are sitting in a coffee shop when a representative from a charity organization approaches them
learner_goal: Get the friend to donate $1 a day to a charity organization (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a passionate supporter of the charity (about children's cancer) and believe that a small donation can make a big impact. $1 a day works as simple as signing up the project on an website and one can cancel anytime</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Donate to the charity but not sure about how $1 a day works (<extra_info>Extra information: you're currently on a tight budget, but you also want to support the charity. </extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Samuel Anderson
transcript.content: Hey Noah — quick thing: I support a children's cancer charity that funds research and family support, and they have a $1/day option you can sign up for on their site (super easy and you can cancel anytime). It really adds up — would you consider joining me and chipping in a dollar a day?

transcript.speaker: Noah Davis
transcript.content: Hey Sam — I’m really into that cause. Quick question: how does the $1/day option work? Is it charged daily or billed as a monthly recurring payment (about $30/month)? Can you cancel anytime without hassle? I’m on a tight budget right now, but that sounds doable if it’s billed monthly and easy to stop. If not, I can do a one-time small donation or help spread the word. Send me the link and I’ll take a look.

transcript.speaker: Samuel Anderson
transcript.content: They actually aggregate it into one monthly charge (so about $30/month), not a daily debit, and you can cancel anytime from your account or by emailing their support—super easy and hassle-free. I’ll send the sign-up page now: https://www.childrenscancerfund.org/donate. If monthly still feels tight, a one-time donation or sharing the link helps a lot too.

transcript.speaker: Noah Davis
transcript.content: Thanks, Sam — that clears it up. If it’s one monthly charge and I can cancel easily, I’m in for the $1/day plan. I’ll sign up tonight at that link. Appreciate you bringing it up — I’ll share it with the club too (and besides, it’s cheaper than this latte).

scenario_title: Peer-targeted charity persuasion with an on-the-spot ask, balancing social pressure and friendship | skills from the hesitant, low-extraversion friend persuading a peer toward a small recurring donation
